test_mode: direct production MCP; conversational activation and refusal not tested

result.instructions: BidReady helps organizations decide whether to bid and prepare compliant responses. Authoritative tender documents always override extracted assumptions.

tools.name: score_bid_opportunity
tools.description: Score a tender, RFP, or bid opportunity after the workflow has extracted eligibility, mandatory requirement coverage, critical gaps, strategic fit, delivery fit, evidence readiness, workload, and deadline. Returns BID, CONDITIONAL_BID, or NO_BID decision support; it does not guarantee an award.
tools.title: score bid opportunity

positive.prompt:
We pass eligibility, cover 19 of 20 mandatory requirements, have no critical gaps, strategic fit 90, delivery fit 90, evidence 90, 24 hours of work and 10 days left. Should we bid?

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"critical_gaps": 0, "days_to_deadline": 10, "delivery_fit": 90, "eligibility_pass": true, "estimated_response_hours": 24, "evidence_readiness": 90, "mandatory_covered": 19, "mandatory_total": 20, "strategic_fit": 90}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
